stories.title: FedEx St. Jude Championship — Playoffs Begin Thursday in Memphis
stories.angle: The FedEx Cup Playoffs begin Thursday, August 13, at TPC Southwind in Memphis. The 70-player field is locked. Scottie Scheffler enters as the No. 1 seed and the +500 favorite. Rory McIlroy (+1,300) returns from his selective summer schedule. The format: top 50 of 70 advance to the BMW Championship (Bellerive CC, St. Louis, Aug 20-23); top 30 advance to the Tour Championship (East Lake, Atlanta, Aug 27-30). TPC Southwind is a 7,233-yard Par 70 with narrow fairways and small greens. Conditions: highs near 93°F with 10-20 mph winds. $20M purse; 750 FedExCup points.

stories.title: Scottie Scheffler — 1 Win, 5 Runner-Ups, and a POTY Race He Could Lose
stories.angle: Scheffler heads into the playoffs as FedExCup leader and World No. 1 (167th consecutive week), yet has just 1 win in 2026 (The American Express, January, his 20th career win). He has 5 runner-up finishes and 9 top-5s but 0 major titles. Chris Gotterup leads the PGA Tour with 3 wins, making him the primary POTY rival. Golf Channel analyst Johnson Wagner predicts Scheffler needs 2 more wins in the playoffs to clinch POTY. Scheffler quote: "I've been really close to winning some tournaments, and that can be frustrating."

stories.title: Rory McIlroy — Chasing a Record 4th FedExCup Title
stories.angle: McIlroy returns to competition at the FedEx St. Jude Championship after skipping multiple regular-season events (RBC Heritage, Cadillac, Travelers). He won back-to-back Masters titles (2025, 2026) and The Players Championship in 2026, giving him 6 career majors (ties Mickelson, Faldo, Trevino). He has 3 FedExCup titles (2016, 2019, 2022); a 4th would be a record. He finished 32nd at the US Open and 40th at The Open Championship in 2026. Confirmed start in Memphis (+1,300 odds).

stories.title: Jon Rahm — 3rd Straight LIV Individual Championship
stories.angle: Rahm clinched his 3rd consecutive LIV Individual Championship at LIV Golf New York (Bedminster), finishing T41 — his worst result of the season. Final standings: Rahm 944.54 pts vs. DeChambeau 726.20 (margin: 218+ pts). 2026: 2 wins (Hong Kong, Mexico City), 4 runner-ups, 8 top-10s in first 9 starts. Since joining LIV (2024): 1 finish outside top 10 in 25 career LIV starts. LIV Indianapolis (Aug 20-23, Chatham Hills, Westfield, Indiana) is next. BC Partners deal signed; closes September 2026; players become majority equity holders.

stories.title: LPGA — Shiho Kuwaki Wins AIG Women's Open; Portland Classic Starts Thursday
stories.angle: Shiho Kuwaki (Japan) won the 50th AIG Women's Open at Royal Lytham & St Annes on August 2 in a 2-hole playoff over Esther Henseleit (Germany). Both finished regulation at -5 (279). Henseleit holed a 40-foot birdie on the 72nd hole to force the playoff; in sudden death, her tee shot hit a marshal and finished in a bush → bogey. Kuwaki made par to win. Yealimi Noh (USA) led by 3 entering Sunday but shot 74 to finish T3 at -4. Kuwaki's prize: $1.5M from record $10M purse; Japan's 2nd straight AIG Women's Open champion. Next: The Standard Portland Classic begins Thursday, August 13, at Columbia Edgewater CC, Portland, OR ($2M purse).
